questions.q: What is the largest animal on Earth?
questions.a: The blue whale — it can grow longer than three school buses.

questions.q: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.a: Three. Two pump blood to the gills and one pumps blood to the rest of the body.

questions.q: What kind of animal is a starfish?
questions.a: An echinoderm, not a fish — that is why scientists often call it a sea star.

questions.q: Which part of a sailfish rises above its back like a sail?
questions.a: Its dorsal fin. Dorsal means on the back.

questions.q: What do sharks have instead of bones?
questions.a: Cartilage — the same bendy material that is inside your ears and nose.

questions.q: How many arms does an octopus have?
questions.a: Eight. The name "octopus" comes from a word meaning eight.

questions.q: Which sea animal is known as the "clown of the sea" and lives in anemones?
questions.a: The clownfish — it hides safely among the stinging anemone tentacles.

questions.q: What is the largest type of fish in the ocean?
questions.a: The whale shark — it is a gentle giant that eats tiny plankton.

questions.q: Are dolphins fish or mammals?
questions.a: Mammals. They breathe air with lungs and feed their babies milk.

questions.q: What is the largest land animal?
questions.a: The African elephant — it can weigh more than a small truck.

questions.q: What is the fastest land animal?
questions.a: The cheetah — it can sprint up to about 70 miles per hour.

questions.q: What is the tallest animal in the world?
questions.a: The giraffe — its long neck helps it reach leaves high in the trees.

questions.q: Which big cat is known as the "king of the jungle"?
questions.a: The lion, even though lions actually live on grassy savannas, not jungles.

questions.q: What do pandas mostly eat?
questions.a: Bamboo — they spend many hours each day munching on it.

questions.q: Which animal has black and white stripes and looks like a striped horse?
questions.a: The zebra. Every zebra has its own unique stripe pattern.

questions.q: Which great ape is the largest living primate?
questions.a: The gorilla. Adult males are called silverbacks because the hair on their backs turns silver.

questions.q: Which animal has a long trunk it uses like a hand?
questions.a: The elephant. It uses its trunk to grab food, drink water, and even hug.

questions.q: Which bird can swim but cannot fly?
questions.a: The penguin — it uses its wings like flippers to swim underwater.

questions.q: What is the largest bird in the world?
questions.a: The ostrich — it is too heavy to fly but can run very fast.

questions.q: Which bird is known for copying human words?
questions.a: The parrot. Some parrots can learn dozens of words.

questions.q: What bird can fly backward?
questions.a: The hummingbird — it can also hover in one spot like a tiny helicopter.

questions.q: What color is a flamingo when it is born?
questions.a: Gray or white. Flamingos turn pink from the shrimp and algae they eat.

questions.q: Which bird is a symbol of wisdom and can turn its head almost all the way around?
questions.a: The owl — it can turn its head about three-quarters of the way around.

questions.q: What do you call a baby bird that has just hatched from its egg?
questions.a: A chick (or hatchling).

questions.q: Which large bird is the national bird of the United States?
questions.a: The bald eagle.

questions.q: How many legs does a spider have?
questions.a: Eight. Spiders are arachnids, not insects (insects have six legs).

questions.q: How many legs does an insect have?
questions.a: Six. That is one way to tell an insect apart from a spider.

questions.q: What do bees collect from flowers to make honey?
questions.a: Nectar — they turn it into honey back in the hive.

questions.q: What does a caterpillar turn into?
questions.a: A butterfly or a moth, after a change called metamorphosis.

questions.q: Which insect can lift many times its own body weight?
questions.a: The ant — ants are incredibly strong for their tiny size.

questions.q: What insect makes a glowing light in the dark on summer nights?
questions.a: The firefly (also called a lightning bug).

questions.q: How many spots does a common ladybug usually have?
questions.a: It varies, but the common seven-spot ladybug has seven black spots.

questions.q: What do you call a group of bees that live and work together?
questions.a: A colony (and the home they build is called a hive).

questions.q: Which reptile carries its home on its back?
questions.a: The turtle (and the tortoise) — its shell is part of its body.

questions.q: What is the largest reptile in the world?
questions.a: The saltwater crocodile — it can grow longer than a car.

questions.q: How does a snake smell the air around it?
questions.a: With its tongue. It flicks its tongue out to pick up scents.

questions.q: Which lizard can change the color of its skin?
questions.a: The chameleon. It changes color to blend in and to show its mood.

questions.q: Are frogs reptiles or amphibians?
questions.a: Amphibians — they start life in water as tadpoles before growing legs.

questions.q: What is the only continent where you will not find any snakes living in the wild?
questions.a: Antarctica — it is far too cold for snakes.

questions.q: What do you call a baby frog?
questions.a: A tadpole. It has a tail and gills before it grows into a frog.

questions.q: Which reptile is famous for moving very, very slowly?
questions.a: The tortoise — but the slow-and-steady tortoise can live for over 100 years.

questions.q: What is a baby kangaroo called?
questions.a: A joey. It rides in its mother's pouch until it is big enough to hop on its own.

questions.q: What is a baby dog called?
questions.a: A puppy.

questions.q: What is a baby cat called?
questions.a: A kitten.

questions.q: Which animal is known as "man's best friend"?
questions.a: The dog — dogs have lived alongside people for thousands of years.

questions.q: What is a baby horse called?
questions.a: A foal (a young male is a colt and a young female is a filly).

questions.q: How many legs does a cat have?
questions.a: Four.

questions.q: What is a baby cow called?
questions.a: A calf.

questions.q: What small furry pet is famous for running on a spinning wheel?
questions.a: The hamster.

questions.q: What is a baby rabbit called?
questions.a: A kit (or kitten). A group of baby rabbits is called a litter.
